delta_review.summary: The immediate delta publishes the d85703a approval in two synchronized F6 documents. Revalidating that approval against the complete producer-to-consumer recovery path exposed three missed current-head contract failures.
delta_review.evidence: All immediate delta files were inspected, the six-commit 3f792e4-to-1e56b00 remediation history was reconciled, the affected base-to-head recovery graph was traced, and discriminating current-head probes reproduced the failures.

finding_revalidation.evidence: ACCESSIBILITY_ACTION_UNSUPPORTED is declared, included in COMPUTER_USE_FAILURE_KINDS, documented, emitted, normalized, and asserted against the public tuple for both native unsupported cases.

The response-internal matrix is stricter, but an internally valid AXSetFocus/-25205 response for an AXPress request is still accepted and followed by a click because the requested action is never compared.

decision.rationale: PRR-025 is resolved, but PRR-021, PRR-022, and PRR-026 are open at the current head. Production-shaped definite-unsupported results cannot use the documented safe fallback, while request-mismatched or malformed evidence can still authorize a second mutation.

summary: The latest documentation delta and exact-head CI are clean, and the new public failure value is registered correctly. Approval renewal is nevertheless withheld: tests fabricate an action field that the real native failure producer omits, the strict proof is not bound to the requested action, and older attempt/dispatch extractors ignore malformed present values. These gaps respectively disable the intended production fallback or permit an unsafe second desktop mutation.

findings.title: Malformed attempt or dispatch evidence can still replay an Accessibility action
findings.observation: The attempted and dispatch extractors append only valid booleans. Present malformed values are silently discarded; ComputerUseClient also coerces actionAttempted with bool(), so a falsey malformed value becomes trusted false. The shared fallback predicate can then treat uncertain evidence as safe.
findings.trigger: A compatible, version-skewed, or malformed backend reports unsupported_operation with actionAttempted as a non-boolean, or a retryable result carries requestDispatched=false plus a malformed duplicate.
findings.impact: One semantic operation can execute accessibility_action and then click after the first desktop outcome is not safely proven, violating the no-replay boundary across every shared caller.

evidence.description: unsupported_operation plus actionAttempted='true' produced operations [accessibility_action, click] and success.
A retryable timeout with one requestDispatched=false copy and one malformed 'true' duplicate also produced [accessibility_action, click].
ComputerUseClient promotes actionAttempted with bool(payload.get(...)); WeChat ignores present non-boolean copies in both attempted and dispatch collectors.

findings.remediation: Make attempt and dispatch evidence presence-sensitive. Any present malformed container, value, alias, or inconsistent duplicate must yield invalid/unknown and fail closed; do not coerce untrusted attempted evidence with bool(). Apply the same result to every shared fallback caller.
findings.verification: Add producer-to-consumer tests for truthy and falsey malformed attempted values, malformed dispatch aliases/duplicates, missing evidence, and conflicts. Every unsafe case must execute only accessibility_action; valid pre-dispatch and explicitly unsupported cases must preserve exactly one allowed fallback.

findings.title: The strict proof rejects real native unsupported results because the producer omits action
findings.observation: The WeChat gate now requires action evidence, but the generated native failure helper has no action parameter and the AXPress/-25206 and AXSetFocus/-25205 failure branches do not emit action. Tests manually add a field that production never sends.
findings.trigger: The real direct backend returns either documented definite unsupported native error and a higher-level WeChat path evaluates whether to use its configured fallback.
findings.impact: The documented compatibility fallback is disabled in production for mapped navigation, contact opening, search focus/results, node clicking, and public actionRef execution, so valid semantic operations fail unnecessarily.

evidence.description: Production-shaped AXPress/-25206 and AXSetFocus/-25205 payloads passed through real ComputerUseClient normalization retained no action and both returned fallbackAllowed=false.
The generated fail() payload emits failureKind, attempted state, effect, code, and target but not action; the consumer requires a non-empty action.
Current fixtures inject action in synthetic payloads, masking the production contract mismatch while all broad suites remain green.

findings.remediation: Define one end-to-end action proof contract: the native unsupported result must carry the actual requested action, or the expected action must be bound through an equivalently trustworthy normalization path before recovery is evaluated.
findings.verification: Execute the real generated failure path through ComputerUseClient and WeChat for AXPress/-25206 and AXSetFocus/-25205. Each matching result must use exactly one configured fallback, while uncertain results use none.

findings.title: Unsupported proof is not compared with the action that was actually requested
findings.observation: The strict predicate checks only that response fields form an internally valid AXPress/-25206 or AXSetFocus/-25205 tuple. It receives no expected action and never compares the response with the command input.
findings.trigger: A custom, version-skewed, stale, or malformed backend returns a complete AXSetFocus/-25205 proof for an AXPress request, or the inverse.
findings.impact: The result can authorize a selector, coordinate, Return, focus, or strategy fallback after the actual requested action has an unknown effect, causing a second mutation.

evidence.description: An AXPress request plus an internally consistent AXSetFocus/-25205 response made proof_accepted=true and produced [accessibility_action, click] with success.
All recovery callers invoke the same result-only predicate, so none can enforce request/response action equality.
The wrong-pair regression changes a response code while keeping one response action; it does not cover an internally valid response tuple that differs from the request.

findings.remediation: Pass or otherwise bind the expected request action into the recovery decision, require every response action copy to equal it, and keep all existing type, duplicate, effect, attempted-state, and native-code checks fail closed.
findings.verification: Matching AXPress and AXSetFocus results each permit exactly one configured fallback. Both request/response mismatch directions and every missing, malformed, duplicated, or contradictory variant execute zero fallback across all callers.

findings.title: New package failure was missing from the stable routing tuple
findings.observation: ACCESSIBILITY_ACTION_UNSUPPORTED now owns the emitted value and is included in COMPUTER_USE_FAILURE_KINDS.
findings.trigger: A direct native unsupported action result is routed by a tuple-based package consumer.
findings.impact: The result is now classified through the advertised stable package failure contract.

evidence.description: Both normalized native unsupported observations assert tuple membership and the current package suite passes.
The named constant and tuple entry are present at the current head.

findings.verification: Both real normalized failure kinds belong to COMPUTER_USE_FAILURE_KINDS and package/root/CI checks pass.

required_actions.action: Reject every present malformed or contradictory attempted/dispatch value without boolean coercion, and add zero-replay coverage at every shared fallback path.
Make the production native unsupported result and normalization path carry a trustworthy actual action, then prove both real valid pairs retain one fallback.
Bind the recovery proof to the requested action and add both request/response mismatch directions as zero-fallback regressions.
Register accessibility_action_unsupported and verify emitted observations against the stable tuple.
After the behavior is fixed and re-reviewed, regenerate F5/F6 evidence and synchronize merge-readiness plus the live/tracked PR description before merge.

assumptions.statement: A definite unsupported native error can authorize fallback only for the same action that was actually requested.
assumptions.method: Trace the command input, native constants, documented no-effect exception, and every recovery caller; execute a mismatched-action counterexample.
assumptions.evidence: The documented exception is action-specific, and the mismatched response executed a second mutation without proving the requested action had no effect.
assumptions.impact_if_false: Response-internal proof could safely authorize fallback for a different requested mutation, contradicting the no-replay contract.

assumptions.statement: Present malformed attempt or dispatch evidence must not be treated as evidence of no attempt or no dispatch.
assumptions.method: Compare the fail-closed API/design contract with extractor behavior and execute malformed truthy, falsey, and duplicate probes.
assumptions.evidence: The contract blocks malformed and contradictory evidence; current extractors instead permit a second operation in controlled reproductions.
assumptions.impact_if_false: Unknown first-action outcomes could be retried based on invalid producer data.

assumptions.statement: Green broad tests and CI cannot override a deterministic current-head counterexample outside their fixture coverage.
assumptions.method: Run all configured suites and compare their synthetic fixtures with the generated production payload and new invariants.
assumptions.evidence: All suites and exact-head CI pass, while three discriminating probes fail and the fixtures contain a production-absent action field.
assumptions.impact_if_false: A known reproducible safety or compatibility failure would be ignored solely because the existing suite lacks the trigger.

non_blocking_recommendations.recommendation: Derive cross-package result fixtures from the real generated action producer instead of manually duplicating its fields.
non_blocking_recommendations.value: This prevents tests from proving contracts that production does not emit.

non_blocking_recommendations.recommendation: Represent action-recovery evidence as a parsed valid/invalid/absent object consumed by one expected-action-aware policy.
non_blocking_recommendations.value: This makes malformed presence and request binding explicit instead of relying on several lossy collectors.

non_blocking_recommendations.recommendation: Keep the final release note explicit about dispatch-aware no-replay and the narrow definite-unsupported exception.
non_blocking_recommendations.value: Consumers need both sides of the recovery contract when diagnosing desktop behavior.
